records.title: footer X link points to its Sauce Labs URL
records.acText: WHEN any authenticated user is on the inventory page, the footer shall expose a social link whose href is exactly https://x.com/saucelabs.

records.title: footer Facebook link points to its Sauce Labs URL
records.acText: WHEN any authenticated user is on the inventory page, the footer Facebook link's href shall be https://www.facebook.com/saucelabs.

records.title: footer LinkedIn link points to its Sauce Labs URL
records.acText: WHEN any authenticated user is on the inventory page, the footer LinkedIn link's href shall be https://www.linkedin.com/company/sauce-labs/.

records.title: footer X link shows the label X
records.acText: WHEN any authenticated user is on the inventory page, the footer's X social link shall display the visible text "X".

records.title: footer Facebook link shows the label Facebook
records.acText: WHEN any authenticated user is on the inventory page, the footer's Facebook social link shall display the visible text "Facebook".

records.title: footer LinkedIn link shows the label LinkedIn
records.acText: WHEN any authenticated user is on the inventory page, the footer's LinkedIn social link shall display the visible text "LinkedIn".

records.title: footer copyright line matches the browser's current year
records.acText: WHEN any authenticated user is on the inventory page, the footer copyright line shall read '© <current year> Sauce Labs. All Rights Reserved. Terms of Service | Privacy Policy', where <current year> is read from the browser's own clock at the time the assertion runs rather than hardcoded.
